title: Connection
description: Connection record: a person's access to their own account at an external service (SEC-7). The person creates it through the consent adapter; the deployment keeps the token value under token_ref, and the value never passes through P1-P4. A plugin with credential.per_principal gets the connection of the task's initiator only. Lifecycle: spec/lifecycles/connection.md.

id.description: Connection id with the prefix cn_.

principal.description: The person who owns the connection; only human.

provider.description: Provider from the tenant catalog connection_providers.

scopes.description: Granted scopes; the person chose them on the consent screen.

token_ref.description: Reference to the token in the deployment secret store; never the value.

expires_at.description: Expiry; at most max_days of the provider.

revoke_reason.description: Who or what revoked the connection.
